description: Baseline scenario pack: generic per-token energy rates are not calibrated to any model or serving hardware. Cached input is modeled separately from fresh input. Every figure is measured ledger usage multiplied by assumptions; the ledger stores no modeled energy. Supply a calibrated pack for model-specific estimates.
disclaimer: Energy rates are uncalibrated scenarios, not measurements; cache-read bounds are illustrative. Local hardware and serving location require their own pack. Pricing is a placeholder.

grid.source: CodeCarbon world-average grid intensity fallback. For time/region-specific carbon, replace this scalar with an `intensity_by_date` list — [{"from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "gco2e_per_kwh": N}, ...] — and `estimate` fixes each commit's intensity from its own timestamp.

provenance.source: CodeCarbon global energy mix (world-average fallback, 475 gCO2e/kWh)
provenance.note: World average; replace with codecarbon's per-country/region values or a live source for accuracy.

provenance.source: Generic per-token energy scenario; model and hardware dependent
provenance.note: The cited benchmark demonstrates that energy varies with model size, serving engine, workload, and hardware; it does not calibrate this pack's 0.0003 Wh/output-token or 0.00003 Wh/fresh-input-token constants. These are generic scenarios, not measured values for a particular model.

Cached prefixes skip repeated prefill computation. Cache-read token energy is modeled from zero to the full fresh-input rate, with a 10% central scenario; these fractions are illustrative, not measured energy rates.
1.2 as an industry-typical assumption; set your operator's PUE if known.
Illustrative per-Mtok rates; replace with your contracted rates. Unlisted models default to $0 (unknown).
